title: Press, Move, Happen
goal: Input → action → result. That's a game.
mascot_lines: Every game works the same way underneath.
You press a button, the hero does something, and you see what happened.
Press right and the hero walks right. Bump a coin and the score goes up.
Press, do, see — that little loop is the secret heart of every game.

tier2.rephrase: Order the three steps: input, action, result.

tier3.nudge: First the kid does something. Then the hero. Then the game!
